notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but has no preview-image collection or storage.
REF-BM-10: Existing tags are exposed by an API but the tag editor provides no autocomplete UI.
REF-BM-14: #tag is parsed as ordinary full text rather than a tag-specific condition, allowing false-positive field matches.
REF-BM-21: Bulk selection applies only to up to 100 currently visible items, not the whole filtered collection.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF-preservation implementation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: No bundle entity or saved-filter workflow exists.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No personal display-settings model or UI exists.
